feature: Stage J NPC salvage original cargo to native warehouse
prerequisites: Use authorized disposable world copy, never production evejs-data
Pinned EveJS upstream and manual opt-in A-Life salvage flags
Actual original source-tagged NPC wreck, legal NPC loot-right corporation, real station

scenarios.action: Source NPC physically takes original wreck cargo, approaches real station
scenarios.expected: Same native cargo ID debited and single corporation-owned native item credited with immutable rival receipt

scenarios.action: Retry after successful native cargo-to-station transfer and restart
scenarios.expected: No second station item; same native item ID and owner

scenarios.action: Mutate original cargo owner between preflight and SQLite transaction on disposable GameStore
scenarios.expected: No station credit, original cargo unchanged by transaction

scenarios.action: Mutate source wreck ID or original salvage manifest after preflight
scenarios.expected: No item minted, explicit native custody mismatch

scenarios.action: Mutate durable NPC rival pickup receipt after preflight
scenarios.expected: Fail closed, no cargo debit or inventory credit

scenarios.action: Remove native nextItemID allocator on test copy
scenarios.expected: Fail closed rather than guessing new item ID

scenarios.expected: COMMITTED_NEEDS_RECONCILIATION; no false warehouse CONFIRMED and no blind retry

scenarios.action: NPC engaged by enemy during intended station delivery
scenarios.expected: NPC prioritizes combat, no warehouse inventory mutation
No native rival warehouse stock movements
